clips.title: The story
paras: Daphne Stilwell tends an isolated orchard nestled atop the coastal cliffs of Westfall overlooking the Longshore. Together with her husband Jordan, she fled turmoil in the north and relocated south, quietly aiding the Church of the Holy Light while defending her home from nearby outlaws.

Perched on the bluffs to the west of Moonbrook and the exit of the Deadmines, Daphne Stilwell manages a secluded homestead and apple orchard. From below along the Longshore or above on gryphon routes south to Stranglethorn Vale, the small farm looks quiet and unassuming. Yet running a homestead in modern Westfall is anything but safe. Despite the encroaching bandits and roaming scavengers, Daphne diligently works her trees and keeps watch over her isolated patch of land.
